answer.thought: Sunil’s casualness is a form of freedom I do not possess; he takes the money without the friction of accounting, while I am still calculating the cost of my own existence. The samosa is not merely food, but a necessary interruption to the abstract hunger that has been gnawing at me since morning. I will eat it standing here, in the market, where the system of needs is most visible.
